stem:
The diagram shows Aanya's incandescent torch lamp. The thin wire inside the glass bulb is continuous, with no break. She also keeps an LED torch at home.

Which claim is correct?

options.text: This lamp can glow when connected to a cell, because its filament is intact.
The glass bulb produces the light, so an unbroken bulb is enough even if the filament is ignored.
This lamp will glow without a cell, because its filament is intact.
The LED torch cannot glow, because it has no filament.

teacher.key_rationale: An incandescent torch lamp glows when current can heat an intact filament. The glass is not the light source, a cell is still required, and LED lamps are outside this filament rule.
teacher.figure_note: Rewrote circuitikz source into an incandescent torch lamp with continuous filament.
